description_en: Modifies the configuration of an access control policy for a NAT firewall
description_zh: 修改NAT防火墙安全访问控制策略的配置信息
name: ModifyNatFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:
accept: Allows the traffic.
drop: Denies the traffic.
log: Monitors the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中流量通过云防火墙的方式。取值：
accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en:
The description of the access control policy. Fuzzy match is supported.
If you do not specify this parameter, the descriptions of all policies are queried
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的描述信息。支持模糊查询。

不设置该参数表示查询所有策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The destination port for traffic in the access control policy of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.
Specify this parameter when DestPortType is set to `port`
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口。

当DestPortType为`port`时，设置该参数
parameters.name: dest_port

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the access control policy.
If DestinationType is set to net, Destination is the destination CIDR block. Example: 1.2.3.4/24.
If DestinationType is set to group, Destination is the name of the destination address book. Example: db_group.
If DestinationType is set to domain, Destination is the destination domain name. Example: *.aliyuncs.com.
If DestinationType is set to location, Destination is the destination region. For the region codes, see the following section. Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的目的地址。

当DestinationType为net时，Destination为目的CIDR。例如：1.2.3.4/24
当DestinationType为group时，Destination为目的地址簿名称。例如：db_group
当DestinationType为domain时，Destination为目的域名。例如：*.aliyuncs.com
当DestinationType为location时，Destination为目的区域（具体区域位置编码见后文）。例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy. Valid values:
net: destination CIDR block.
group: destination address book.
domain: destination domain name.
location: destination region
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
location：目的区域
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh: NAT网关的ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the security protocol for traffic in the access control policy. Supported protocol types:
ANY
TCP
UDP
ICMP
ANY indicates that the policy applies to all types of applications.
If the destination address is a threat intelligence address book or a cloud service address book of the domain name type, you can set this parameter to TCP. If you select TCP, you can select HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SMTPS, or SSL as the application
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中流量访问的安全协议类型。支持的应用类型有以下几种：

ANY
TCP
UDP
ICMP

ANY表示策略应用在所有类型的应用中。

访问的目的地址为域名类型的威胁情报地址簿或云服务地址簿时，可选配置TCP协议。选择TCP时，应用可选HTTP/HTTPS/SMTP/SMTPS/SSL五种
parameters.name: proto

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the access control policy. Valid values:
If SourceType is set to `net`, Source is the source CIDR block. Example: 10.2.XX.XX/24.
If SourceType is set to `group`, Source is the name of the source address book. Example: db_group
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址。取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，Source为源CIDR地址，例如：10.2.XX.XX/24

当SourceType为`group`时，Source为源地址簿名称，例如：db_group
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the access control policy.
To delete an access control policy, you must provide the UUID of the policy. You can call the DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy operation to obtain the UUID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

删除安全访问控制策略，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用DescribeNatFirewallControlPolicy接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction of the access control policy. Valid values:
out: outbound traffic
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的流量方向。取值：
out：内对外流量
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy. Valid values:
net: source CIDR block.
group: source address book
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址类型。取值：

net：源网段（CIDR地址）
group：源地址簿
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination port for traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:
port: port.
group: port address book
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口类型。

port：端口
group：端口地址簿
parameters.name: dest_port_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination port address book for traffic in the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口地址簿名称
parameters.name: dest_port_group

parameters.help_en:
The status of the access control policy. Valid values:
true: The policy is enabled.
false: The policy is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略的状态。取值：

true：策略开启状态

false：策略关闭状态
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en: The names of the applications
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称
parameters.name: application_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The domain name resolution method of the access control policy. Valid values:
0: FQDN-based resolution.
1: DNS-based dynamic resolution.
2: FQDN and DNS-based dynamic resolution.
If the domain name identification mode includes FQDN, only the TCP protocol is allowed. You can select HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SMTPS, SSL, IMAPS, or POPS as the application
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

0：基于FQDN
1：基于DNS动态解析
2：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析

域名识别模式包含FQDN时，只允许配置TCP协议，应用可选HTTP/HTTPS/SMTP/SMTPS/SSL/IMAPS/POPS
parameters.name: domain_resolve_type

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent (default): Always.
None: Specified single time.
Daily: Every day.
Weekly: Every week.
Monthly: Every month
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月
parameters.name: repeat_type

parameters.help_en:
The set of recurrence days for the policy validity period of the access control policy.
If RepeatType is set to `Permanent`, `None`, or `Daily`, RepeatDays is an empty set. Example: [].
If RepeatType is set to Weekly, RepeatDays cannot be empty. Example: [0, 6].
If RepeatType is set to Weekly, the values in RepeatDays must be unique.
If RepeatType is set to `Monthly`, RepeatDays cannot be empty. Example: [1, 31].
If RepeatType is set to Monthly, the values in RepeatDays must be unique
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期集合。
当RepeatType为`Permanent`、`None`、`Daily`时，RepeatDays为空集合。
  例如：[]
当RepeatType为Weekly时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[0, 6]
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，RepeatDays不允许重复。
当RepeatType为`Monthly`时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[1, 31]
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，RepeatDays不允许重复
parameters.name: repeat_days

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence start time when the policy takes effect. Use the 24-hour time format HH:mm, such as 08:00. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the recurrence end time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatStartTime is empty. If RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatStartTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的重复开始时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如08:00，必须为整点或半点时间，且小于重复结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间
parameters.name: repeat_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence end time when the policy takes effect. Use the 24-hour time format HH:mm, such as 23:30. The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes later than the recurrence start time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatEndTime is empty. If RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatEndTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的重复结束时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如23:30，必须为整点或半点时间，且大于重复开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间
parameters.name: repeat_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format (seconds). The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the end time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent, StartTime is empty. If RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, StartTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且小于结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，StartTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，StartTime必须有值，您需要设置开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Specify the time in the UNIX timestamp format (seconds). The time must be on the hour or half-hour, and must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If RepeatType is set to Permanent, EndTime is empty. If RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, EndTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间
parameters.name: end_time
